notes.title: 💀 Host Mortem Dev Dispatch
notes.content:
:warning: NOTE: Host Mortem is not out yet — but you can wishlist it and help raise it from the dead:
:point_right: Wishlist NOW!

It’s been a productive few weeks in the crypt. Here’s what we’ve summoned, stitched, and reanimated in Host Mortem — the rogue-like where you’re already dead, and things only get worse from there.
🧠 AI Upgrades: Now With 87% More Regret
The monsters in Host Mortem have evolved from wandering meatbags into cunning horrors with actual brain cells (well, metaphorical ones). We've wired in full behavior trees, meaning:  Goblins flee and flank like cowards with ambition.  Slimes wobble with intent.  Beholders drift ominously with that “I read minds and judge” vibe.Enemies now patrol, chase, and hesitate. You’ll even see thought bubbles showing what they think they’re doing. (Hint: it’s rarely helpful for you.)
⚔️ Combat Polish: Now With More Ouch
Attacks now hit where they should (mostly), and when they do, you’ll know it — thanks to:  Improved hurtboxes, direction-based swings, and animated pain.  Every entity gets a health bar. So you can watch them suffer with clarity.  Unique death animations for each foe. Because everyone dies a little differently.
👻 Possession Overhaul: Ghost Mode Engaged
Possession is the name of the game — literally — and now it feels like it:  Hosts now glow with shader-driven “please haunt me” energy.  Visual FX make entering and exiting bodies feel spiritually satisfying.  A reliable dehost mechanic lets you bail before your ride decomposes.Possession isn't just a mechanic now — it's a lifestyle.
🎨 Visuals & UI: More Dead, More Sexy
  New level art, mood lighting, and polished visual FX breathe eerie life into the crypt.  The UI got a cleanup too — menus that actually behave, controller support, and a main menu that doesn’t look like a placeholder. (Because it’s not anymore.)
🌍 Global Reach: Possessors of the World, Unite
We’re not just haunting in English anymore. Host Mortem is now playable in:  🇺🇸 English  🇪🇸 Spanish  🇯🇵 JapaneseMore to come, depending on who raises their hand... or claw.
🕹️ Steam Integration: The Ghost Is Out of the Vault
  Achievements? Done.  Rich presence? You bet.  Marketing materials? We summoned them via blood ritual (and Inkscape).We’re fully armed and operational for the Steam launch. All that’s missing is your wishlists.

👉 Wishlist Host Mortem on Steam

Yes, this link is haunted. Yes, you should click it anyway.
🎵 QoL & Vibes
  Pause menu? Yes.  Options screen? Absolutely.  Background music? Finally.  Bugs squashed? So many.  Gamepad support? You can now die comfortably from the couch.

Want to see more behind the scenes? I post development updates, sneak peeks, and hauntings on Patreon and Twitch. Come hang out. Or die trying.

— GhostRZZR, Out.
